definitions: Differed in size, amount, degree, or nature from something else of the same general class.
Introduced changes in something so as to make it different or less uniform.
Changed or be changed according to the circumstances or one's needs.
examples: The colours varied from light to dark.
She varied her diet to include more vegetables.
His mood varied throughout the day.
pastTenses: varied (past simple), varied (present perfect), varied (past perfect)
